name: DIY and Garden Products importers and distributors in Germany - Market Entry Study (2026)
description: This market entry study on DIY and garden products in Germany gives foreign manufacturers a compact, practical overview of Europe's largest home-improvement and garden market. It shows how big the market is, who decides on listings and how branded and private-label suppliers can get access. The study ends with a directory of 42 importers, retail buying offices and distribution partners with verified company contact data.

name: DIY & Garden Market Product importers and distributors in Poland – Market Entry Study for Foreign Suppliers (2026)
description: This DIY and garden market entry study for Poland gives foreign manufacturers of branded and private-label products a compact, practical guide to the largest home-improvement market in Central and Eastern Europe. It covers market volume, the key retailers and buying groups, concrete sales opportunities and all market access requirements – plus a verified directory of 34 Polish buying centres, importers and distribution partners.

name: DIY & Garden Market Product importers and distributors in Spain - Market entry study (2026)
description: This market entry study for the DIY and garden market in Spain gives foreign manufacturers a compact, practical guide to one of Europe's fastest-growing home-improvement markets. Large-format DIY stores in Spain and Portugal turned over about EUR 9.3 billion in 2025, almost 10% more than a year earlier. The study shows who buys, what sells and which rules apply – and lists 33 qualified importers and distribution partners with their contact details.

name: DIY & Garden Products importers and distributors in France - Market entry study (2026)
description: This market entry study for the French DIY and garden market gives foreign manufacturers and exporters a compact, practical basis for selling branded or private-label products in France. It combines current market figures, the key retail groups, regulatory access requirements and a directory of 39 buying centrals, importers and distribution partners.

name: DIY & Garden Products Importers and Distributors in Italy - Market Entry Study 2026
description: This market entry study on the DIY and garden market in Italy gives foreign suppliers a compact, fact-based guide to one of Europe's four largest home improvement markets, worth around €17 billion. It explains where demand is growing, who the decisive buyers are and what it takes to get listed, as a brand or as a private-label supplier.

name: Fashion Importers and Distributors in the Czech Republic – Market Entry Study 2026
description: This market entry study on fashion importers in the Czech Republic is written for manufacturers of apparel, footwear and accessories who want to sell in Czechia – under their own brand or as a private-label supplier. It combines a compact market analysis with a verified directory of 35 importers, retailers, online platforms and central buying organisations, so you can contact the right partners straight away.

name: Fashion Importers and Distributors in Germany - Market Entry Study 2026
description: This market entry study on fashion importers and distributors in Germany shows foreign manufacturers and brands how to enter the largest apparel market in the EU. It combines a concise market analysis with a directory of 63 German buyers of fashion from abroad, for private label or under the supplier's brand.

name: Netherlands DIY and Garden market importers and distributors - Market entry study for foreign suppliers 2026
description: This market entry study on the DIY and garden market in the Netherlands shows foreign manufacturers of branded and private-label products where the market stands, who buys, and how to get listed. It combines current market figures, the requirements for suppliers from the EU, non-EU Europe and overseas, and a directory of 20 central buyers, garden centre groups, discounters, platforms and importers with verified contact data.

name: OTC and Consumer Health Importers and Distributors in Norway – Market Entry Study 2026
description: This market entry study on OTC and consumer health importers and distributors in Norway is written for manufacturers and brand owners who want to sell non-prescription medicines, food supplements, OTC medical devices or health-oriented cosmetics in Norway. It combines a compact market analysis with a directory of 26 Norwegian pharmacy groups, wholesalers, retail buyers and distribution partners.

name: UK DIY and Garden Products Importers and Distributors –  Market entry study for the United Kingdom 2026
description: This UK DIY and garden market entry study shows foreign manufacturers how to sell tools, hardware, garden care and outdoor living products in Great Britain. It combines current market figures, the key buyers and the post-Brexit access rules with a directory of 43 UK importers, retail buying offices and distribution partners.
